jeetu-decider-2b.underlying: First measurement of Jeetu456/decider-2b at cd0216309bf590f387500d78d1970af15d04baf5, a Qwen3.5-2B-family fine-tune with a BF16 backbone and FP32 option-pointer decision head. The author's native SystemOne server ran unmodified, with native choice, noul and score probabilities and no generated explanation. The author default abstain threshold 0.55 was frozen before measurement. No answered choice request matched the native English IDK detector, so its choice-only threshold redistribution did not activate. Separately, the scorer records 230 of 373 answered Noul items within its 0.20-0.80 abstention band; this is not attributed to the server's choice threshold. The author documents a threshold-0 alternative, which was not measured. Optional causal-conv1d was omitted in favour of the author's supported F.conv1d fallback, the same maths up to BF16 reassociation; optional-kernel equivalence was not measured. The two weight shards and pointer head share no recorded LFS hashes with 28 compared repositories, including Mapika/decider-2b and Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B. Tokenizer sharing with the base does not imply checkpoint sharing. The model card warns that some When2Call test questions may have been seen during training; training-data contamination against JevBench was not checked. Exactly 1485 answers and 15 preregistered native HTTP 413 over-length refusals; refusals count wrong in the 1500-item denominator, with no evaluator truncation. First 50 responses repeated bit-identically. Earlier provider and installer failures stopped before held-out input and produced no measurement; only the successful recovery attempt is scored.
